description: This file defines the TwigFunction class, which represents a template function within the Twig templating engine. It handles the construction, configuration, and behavior of individual functions used in Twig templates.

classes.name: Twig\TwigFunction
classes.description: Represents a template function in Twig, extending AbstractTwigCallable, allowing configuration of function behavior and safety options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a TwigFunction with a name, an optional callable, and options. Merges default options with provided ones.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the string 'function' indicating the type of Twig element.

methods.name: getParserCallable
methods.description: Retrieves the parser callable from the options, if any.

methods.name: getSafe
methods.description: Determines whether the function's output is safe, based on options or a callback.
